pages.text: Today is apple pie day. Mom sliced the apples thin.
Coco began laying on the apple slices, one by one, in a circle like an open fan.
Mrs. Magpie peered in. "That will take forever! Just pile them on."
She tipped apples into her own pie dish. They made a mountain.
The two pies went into the oven side by side, Coco's and hers.
They waited by the oven. A rich, tart smell drifted out.
The pies came out. Coco's apple fan opened wide.
Mrs. Magpie's mountain had collapsed. The apples had tumbled to one side.
Mom cut Coco's pie into slices to share. Mrs. Magpie received one too.
"...Arranging them in a circle does look pretty." She munched all of her collapsed pie too.
